The '''Central Security Tower''' was the headquarters of the [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Bespin Wing Guard]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was located in [[Plaza district]], a district in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]].
